root.title: Candidate portal
root.body: Open the Apply link on a company’s careers page to start an application, or use the link in any email we’ve sent you.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be out of date.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have access to this.
errors.tenant_not_found: We couldn’t find this company’s portal.
errors.job_not_found: This role isn’t open for applications.
errors.job_closed: This role is no longer accepting applications.
errors.already_submitted: This application has already been submitted.
errors.code_incorrect: That code isn’t right. Check it and try again.
errors.code_invalid_or_expired: That code has expired or been used. Request a new one.
errors.login_expired: Your sign-in took too long. Please try again.
errors.provider_unavailable: That sign-in service isn’t responding. Try another method.
errors.login_failed: We couldn’t sign you in. Please try again.
errors.identity_in_use: That sign-in is already linked to a different account.
errors.email_required: Your provider didn’t share an email address. Please use another sign-in method.
errors.last_sign_in_method: You need to keep at least one way to sign in.
errors.intent_not_found: This link has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.intent_belongs_to_other_account: You’re signed in to a different account.
errors.slot_unavailable: That time was just taken. Please pick another.
errors.too_late_to_change: It’s too close to the start to change the time. Ask your recruiter instead.
errors.interview_not_bookable: This interview can’t be booked right now.
errors.join_not_open_yet: You can join a few minutes before the start time.
errors.time_up: Time is up for this assessment.
errors.attempt_submitted: This assessment has already been submitted.
errors.assessment_submitted: This assessment has already been submitted.
errors.onboarding_locked: Onboarding opens when you accept your offer.
errors.offer_not_found: There’s no offer to show yet.
errors.application_incomplete: A few things are missing before you can submit.
errors.email_not_verified: Please confirm your email address first.
errors.cannot_withdraw: This application can’t be withdrawn now.
errors.csrf_header_missing: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.

auth.subtitle: New here? The same buttons create your account. Use one method every time so your application stays in one place.
auth.codeHint: We’ll send a 6-digit code to verify it’s you. No password needed.
auth.resent: A new code is on its way.
auth.oneAccount: One person, one account. If your email already has a profile, we’ll sign you in to it and ask before linking a new sign-in method.
auth.next2: Upload your CV, and a cover letter if you like
auth.trackAfter: After you apply, sign in here any time to follow your application.
auth.agree: By continuing you agree to the

link.title: Link your {{provider}} sign-in
link.body: An account already exists for {{email}}. To keep everything in one place, sign in with a method you’ve used before, then confirm the link.
link.confirmBody: Add {{provider}} as a way to sign in to {{email}}?
link.wrongAccount: You’re signed in as {{current}}. Sign out, then sign in as {{email}} to link.
link.linked: Linked. You can now sign in with {{provider}}.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: {{provider}} didn’t confirm {{email}} for us. We’ll email you a code to finish signing in.

apply.privacy: We only ask what the hiring team needs. We never ask for — or try to work out — your age, gender, religion, caste or other protected traits.

details.title: Tell us about you
details.signedInAs: Signed in as {{email}}. Please check your details.
details.note: That’s all we need here. Your skills, education and work history come from your CV.

resume.title: Add your resume
resume.formats: PDF, DOC, DOCX or RTF, up to {{mb}} MB
resume.readTitle: Here’s what we read from your CV
resume.readBody: The hiring team sees this summary next to your CV. Fix anything we got wrong.
resume.unavailableBody: We couldn’t read your CV automatically. Add your key skills so the hiring team sees them.
resume.coverHint: A few lines on why this role — or anything your CV doesn’t show.
resume.used1: AI matches your experience to the role’s requirements, so reviewers see the evidence.
resume.used2: A recruiter reviews every application. Nothing is rejected automatically.
resume.used3: We ignore photos, age, gender and other personal traits.

questions.title: A few questions from the hiring team

review.title: Check and submit
review.consentAccuracy: The information I’ve given is accurate, and I understand it will be checked.
review.consentPrivacy: I’ve read the hiring privacy notice, including how AI helps organise my application.
review.talentPool: Keep my profile for other {{tenant}} roles for {{months}} months.
review.after1Body: By email, with a link to track progress

submitted.title: Application sent
submitted.body: Your application for {{job}} is with the {{tenant}} hiring team.
submitted.n2Body: If the role needs one, you’ll take it online.
submitted.n3Body: Book slots, join video calls and get your offer — all in this portal.
submitted.emailNote: We’ll email you whenever something changes. You can also sign in any time to see where things stand.

applications.title: My applications
applications.empty: You haven’t applied for a role here yet.

overview.t1: Every milestone, the moment it happens
overview.t2: What you need to do next, and by when
overview.t3: Scores, interviewer notes and proctoring reviews stay with the hiring team
overview.fair: People make every decision. Nothing is rejected automatically.
overview.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw your application? The hiring team will be told, and you can’t undo this here.

AWAIT_REVIEW.title: A recruiter is reviewing your application
AWAIT_REVIEW.body: We’ll let you know as soon as there’s news. Nothing is rejected automatically.

AWAIT_ASSESSMENT_REVIEW.title: Assessment submitted
AWAIT_ASSESSMENT_REVIEW.body: The hiring team is reviewing it. We’ll be in touch about next steps.

AWAIT_DECISION.title: The hiring team is deciding next steps

READY_TO_START.title: You’re all set
READY_TO_START.bodyNoDate: We’ll share your first-day details soon.

NOT_SELECTED.title: This application is closed
NOT_SELECTED.body: Thank you for applying. The team won’t be moving forward this time.

review_started.title: A recruiter started reviewing your application

assessment.noneBody: If this role needs a technical assessment, it will appear here after screening.
assessment.consent: I’m in a quiet place, I’ll work alone, and I understand my camera and screen are recorded for the hiring team only.
assessment.timerNote: The timer starts when you begin and can’t be paused.
assessment.resultNote: Your result goes to the hiring team alongside your interviews. It isn’t shown here, and it’s never the only reason for a decision.
assessment.tip1: If your connection drops, reopen this page — your answers and time are saved.
assessment.tip2: Need extra time or assistive technology? Request an adjustment before you start.
assessment.submitConfirm: Submit now? You can’t change your answers afterwards.
assessment.submittedBody: Thanks — the hiring team will review it.
assessment.recording: Camera and screen are being recorded for the hiring team.
assessment.shareWholeScreen: Please share your entire screen, not a window or tab.
assessment.timeUp: Time’s up — we’ve submitted your answers.

interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.noneBody: Once the hiring team is ready, you’ll be able to pick times that suit you here.
interviews.video: Video call in this portal — no download needed
interviews.bookBody: Pick any open time. Times are shown in {{tz}}.
interviews.bookBodyBy: Pick any open time before {{date}}. Times are shown in {{tz}}.
interviews.noSlots: There are no open times right now.
interviews.askOther: None of these work? Ask for other times
interviews.askLabel: Which days and times suit you?
interviews.sent: Request sent. Your recruiter will get back to you.
interviews.bookedBody: We’ve emailed a calendar invite. You can join from here {{minutes}} minutes before the start.
interviews.lobbyBody: The panel will let you in when they’re ready. Check your camera and microphone below.

offer.title: Congratulations, {{name}}. We’d love you to join us.
offer.titleFallback: Congratulations. We’d love you to join us.
offer.sub: Take your time to read the offer. Your recruiter is happy to talk anything through.
offer.decisionBody: Accepting opens onboarding, where you’ll upload a few documents before your first day.
offer.signLabel: Type your full name to sign
offer.agree: I accept this offer on the terms set out in the offer letter.
offer.declineBody: The hiring team will be told straight away. If something could change your mind, talk to your recruiter first.
offer.declinedBody: Thanks for letting us know. We’ve told the hiring team.
offer.expiredBody: Contact your recruiter if you’d still like to discuss it.

onboarding.title: Your first day is {{date}}
onboarding.sub: Finish the steps below so everything’s ready when you arrive.
onboarding.formats: PDF, JPG or PNG · up to {{mb}} MB each
onboarding.secure: Stored encrypted. Only HR and the verification team can see your documents.
onboarding.detailsSoon: We’ll share your first-day details soon.
onboarding.locked: Onboarding opens when you accept your offer.

profile.title: My profile
profile.sub: The details the hiring team sees with your application.
profile.signInBody: One person, one account. We only link a sign-in method when you confirm it.
